findings.summary: The new department-dropdown-visual-capture project has no testIgnore, so it runs under a bare npm run test:e2e. This mirrors four sibling on-demand capture projects already in the config — a pre-existing repo-wide convention, not a defect introduced here.
The spec file grew to 814 lines. Test files are exempt from the 200-line source ceiling, but the K-series would eventually read better split by concern.
Uses an inline import('@playwright/test').Page type rather than a top-level type import; copied verbatim from the sibling hashtag capture spec it mirrors.
